path.description: Local path or URL of a JSON array of records.

data.description: Inline records. Used when path is empty.

pathField.description: Property on each record that holds the trip positions. Defaults to path.

timestampsField.description: Property on each record that holds one timestamp per path position. Defaults to timestamps.

useProxy.description: Route requests through the Jupyter server proxy to avoid CORS issues.

httpHeaders.description: HTTP headers forwarded to the upstream server when useProxy is true.
